validation_rules.alias_key_normalization: NFKD, lowercase, strip punctuation and spaces

taxonomy_policies.level1: Problem, capability or application domain. Explicitly label technical domains/umbrella categories.
taxonomy_policies.level2: How learning feedback and demonstrations are organised; not model topology.
taxonomy_policies.level3: Mathematical algorithms, statistical methods or broad modelling frameworks; mark broad types distinctly.
taxonomy_policies.level4: Specific architectures, architecture families or system-integration patterns; explicit subtype required. Not all Level 4 records are neural model topologies.
taxonomy_policies.retained_old_ids: Deprecated records retained with replaced_by_id and not counted as active; where replacement is unknown, retain flagged legacy record.
taxonomy_policies.source_policy: Taxonomy description reviewed using documented source; do not promote entries to Independently Verified until primary evidence is directly assessed.

change_log.notes: Original historical v1.1 unmodified; replacement identifiers preserve provenance. Reviewed at taxonomy boundary; not independent experimental verification.

survival_reconciliation.status: classification reconciled; source metadata and abstract checked; no benchmark or full-paper claim

change_log_v13.description: Add 16 documented, nonduplicate primary-paper-backed architecture components/models and learning algorithms. Preserves original 10-source baseline and v1.2 source.
change_log_v13.limitations: Primary research abstracts/metadata consulted; full paper critical review, independent evaluation and project implementation outstanding.
